synthesis.executive_summary: 今日四篇论文分别指向文档智能的三个关键环节：评估体系、数据效率与模型表示。DocXEval首次把可解释性评估系统化到多模态文档理解，并暴露出现有XAI指标本身可靠性不足的问题；历史文献HTR工作展示了在没有专家转写时利用遗留学术版本进行弱监督的可行路径，并在正字法、词汇、拓扑三层量化收益；离散视觉令牌研究挑战了量化误差决定语义保真度的假设，指出有效比特预算才是关键，并给出因子化向量量化方案；MERLIN则通过一阶、二阶矩路由改进了多状态线性注意力的长上下文聚合效率。对工程团队而言，最直接的信号是：可解释性评估需要谨慎选择指标，历史档案场景可优先考虑弱监督适配，而离散视觉接口和线性注意力在长文档场景中的工程价值正在上升。
synthesis.trend_summary: 文档理解研究正从单一精度指标转向多维评估与数据效率并重：一方面，可解释性、忠实性和偏差诊断被纳入统一基准；另一方面，弱监督和历史版本利用成为低资源场景的主要手段。同时，视觉表示与语言模型融合的接口设计（离散令牌、线性注意力路由）持续受到关注，目标是在保持长上下文能力的同时降低工程复杂度。
common_innovations: 将评估框架系统迁移到多模态文档理解场景，并引入指标间一致性元评估以识别不可靠指标。
利用历史学术版本作为零标签适配与弱监督来源，并按正字法、词汇、拓扑三层分别量化其贡献。
以有效比特预算替代量化误差解释离散视觉令牌的语义保真度，并提出因子化向量量化缓解码本饱和。
在多状态线性注意力中用分段键的一阶、二阶矩实现内容感知的按状态读出聚合。
future_directions: 针对文档特有的布局与视觉区域设计原生可解释性方法，并剔除元评估中表现不可靠的忠实性指标。
在表格理解、键值抽取和生成式多模态大模型上扩展可解释性评估，结合因果干预与反事实分析验证归因结果。
将历史文献的三层弱监督框架推广到无现代转写覆盖的登记册年度，并建立低质量历史版本的自动筛选与加权机制。
改进日期与结构线索的自动解析，提高条目起始定位与边界检测的召回率，并将遗留词表与NER信号更紧密地融入识别解码过程。
针对小字号文本和复杂表格等细粒度文档图像评估离散令牌的语义保真度，并设计任务定制量化器。
建立有效比特预算的可度量指标与理论分析，指导码本规模与视图划分设计，并研究离散表示在生成式OCR中的适用边界。
将矩路由机制扩展到视觉-文本混合的长文档序列，并验证其在百万级令牌场景下的效率与精度权衡。
engineering_takeaways: 企业级文档智能系统可参考DocXEval作为可解释性评估基线，但需注意部分忠实性与复杂度指标不可靠，选型时应优先采用在多个指标上一致的方法。
历史档案和古籍数字化流水线可在缺少专家转写时，利用已有学术版本进行拼写规范化回放和词表监督，以较低成本完成识别器域适配。
采用离散视觉令牌统一next-token预测接口时，应关注有效比特预算而非单纯降低量化误差，因子化向量量化可作为大比特预算下的候选方案。
长文档问答和检索场景可评估MERLIN式矩路由聚合，在不显著增加内存的情况下提升多状态线性注意力的长上下文表现。
可解释性评估应纳入合规审计和数据集偏差发现流程，但对单一指标结论需保持审慎，建议结合多种归因方法交叉验证。

papers.title: DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding
papers.summary: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文提出DocXEval，首个面向多模态文档理解的可解释性系统评估框架，将现有XAI方法与评估指标适配到文本、布局、图像三模态的文档理解场景，并针对语义实体识别等任务引入高效的多目标适配。框架在3个任务、8个数据集、4个模型和17个指标上系统评估了13种XAI方法，发现仅少数方法在所有指标上表现一致，Occlusion整体忠实性与可解释性最佳；元评估显示部分忠实性与复杂度指标间存在中至强一致性，另一些指标结果不可靠；诊断分析还揭示了各模态贡献、空间归因模式及数据集偏差。
papers.novelty: 首次将可解释AI研究方法与评估体系系统迁移到多模态文档理解领域，并构建统一的大规模评测框架。
innovation_points: 提出首个面向多模态（文本、布局、图像）文档理解的可解释性评估框架DocXEval
将13种XAI方法与17种评估指标适配到文档理解场景，并针对语义实体识别等任务设计高效多目标适配
完成跨3任务、8数据集、4模型、17指标的系统性基准评测，并开展指标间一致性的元评估
通过数据集级诊断分析揭示模态贡献、空间归因模式与潜在数据偏差
papers.limitations: 以Occlusion等扰动类方法为主，对基于梯度或注意力的事后可解释方法覆盖有限；元评估显示部分指标结果不可靠，说明评估体系本身尚需校准；诊断分析多基于相关性，未提供因果层面的验证。
improvement_directions: 针对文档特有的布局与视觉区域设计原生可解释性方法，而非直接迁移视觉/语言XAI方法
构建更可靠的忠实性指标并系统校准指标间一致性，剔除不可靠指标
将可解释性评估扩展到更多文档任务（如表格理解、键值抽取）与生成式多模态大模型
结合因果干预与反事实分析，验证归因结果与模型真实决策机制的一致性
papers.engineering_value: 为企业级文档智能系统提供可解释性评估基线，可用于合规审计、模型行为诊断、数据集偏差发现以及高风控场景下的模型选型。

papers.title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
papers.summary: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.
papers.zh_summary: 论文研究教宗Honorius III登记册的手写文本识别，针对现代专家转写仅覆盖Reg. Vat. 9第1-2年度的局限，利用十九世纪Pressutti的regesta与部分刻本作为遗留监督层。作者在双层均存在的fol. 1-203上量化遗留层贡献，发现三个层级的分工：正字法层面，原始刻本单独使用效果有限甚至有害，但投影到教廷拼写并回放现代行后可作为零标签适配目标，在134个第2年度页面上WER降低1.50个百分点（95% CI -1.84至-1.15），缩小与oracle差距的33%；词汇层面，遗留词表覆盖未编辑条目82.2%的OOV词，可66.7%精度标记识别错误，预训练中世纪NER蒸馏进识别器NER头后F1达82.1%；拓扑层面，regest、结尾日期条款及罗马历日期转换可定位73.9%的条目起始行。

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
papers.zh_summary: 论文重新审视离散视觉令牌因量化误差导致语义损失、连续表示构成固有上界的假设。以多模态理解为代理指标，发现量化误差并不可靠，误差更大的离散表示反而可获得更好理解，有效比特预算才是下游性能的关键决定因素。针对现有多码本量化器随比特预算增大而饱和的问题，提出因子化向量量化（Factorized Vector Quantization），用对称并行码本量化视觉特征的互补固定维度视图，在大比特预算下持续提升并最终匹配连续表示。基于工业级多模态数据训练，模型在九项指标平均上超过UniAR 22.8%、Emu3-Chat 59.2%，并首次在离散表示模型中与Qwen3-VL等强连续表示模型具备竞争力。
papers.novelty: 挑战量化误差决定语义保真度的主流假设，指出有效比特预算才是关键，并据此提出可避免饱和的因子化向量量化方法。
innovation_points: 以多模态理解为代理指标实证量化误差与语义保真度不相关，提出有效比特预算作为核心解释变量
设计因子化向量量化：对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视觉特征视图，缓解多码本饱和
首次使离散表示模型在九指标平均上超越UniAR与Emu3-Chat，并与强连续表示模型可比
papers.limitations: 离散令牌在高分辨率、细粒度OCR场景（如小字号文本、复杂表格结构）的保真度仍需专门评估；量化器设计与码本规模带来额外训练与存储开销；对“有效比特预算”的度量与理论解释尚不充分。
improvement_directions: 针对文本密集、细粒度文档图像评估离散令牌的语义保真度并提出任务定制量化器
建立有效比特预算的可度量化指标与理论分析，指导码本与视图划分的设计
探索离散令牌与文档版面、阅读顺序等结构信息的联合建模
研究离散表示在生成式OCR与端到端文档解析中的适用边界
papers.engineering_value: 为多模态文档模型采用统一next-token预测的离散视觉接口提供依据，可降低视觉表示与语言模型融合的工程复杂度，并在大比特预算下保持与连续表示相当的性能。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及视觉离散表示与多模态理解，对OCR中图像令牌化、文档多模态大模型的表示选择有直接启发。

papers.title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
papers.summary: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.
papers.zh_summary: 针对自注意力二次复杂度对长序列建模的限制，论文指出多状态线性注意力（MSLA）在聚合各记忆状态时仅使用查询与段内键的均值对齐，忽略段内对齐分布。为此提出MERLIN，通过跟踪每个分段键的一阶与二阶矩，使查询可恢复其与各段对齐的均值与方差，实现更内容感知的按状态读出聚合。在Gated DeltaNet-1.3B与Mamba-2-780M的多状态变体上，MERLIN在长上下文任务上持续优于现有聚合方法：RULER needle-in-a-haystack与长上下文QA分别提升8.3%和7.0%，LongBench子任务分别提升13.5%和12.0%，甚至优于消耗4倍内存的基线。
papers.novelty: 将分段键的一阶、二阶矩引入多状态线性注意力的路由聚合，用均值-方差对齐替代单一均值对齐。
innovation_points: 提出MERLIN动量路由机制，跟踪每个记忆状态分段的键一阶与二阶矩
查询可同时恢复与分段对齐的均值与方差，实现内容感知的按状态读出聚合
仅需轻量矩统计即可在多状态线性注意力上提升长上下文能力，并优于4倍内存基线
papers.limitations: 方法聚焦长上下文语言建模，未涉及多模态或文档视觉输入；矩统计假设段内键分布可用一阶二阶矩近似，对强非高斯分布的效果未分析；实验限于1.3B与780M规模，更大模型与更长序列的扩展性待验证。
improvement_directions: 将矩路由机制扩展到多模态长文档输入，验证在视觉-文本混合序列上的有效性
